spans.s:
इरिका इरिका, f., N. of a plant or tree.
—इरिका-वन, अम्, n. a grove of such trees.

इरिण इरिण, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. ऋ,
to go; connected with इरा), Ved. a water-course, a
rivulet, a well; any incision in the ground, a hollow,
hole; a desert, an inhospitable region; a bare plain,
barren soil; salt soil.

ईरिण ईरिण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ईर् ?), desert;
(अम्), n. salt and barren soil. See इरिण.

इरिण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging or relating to
a desert &c.

इरिन् इरिन्, ई, इणी, इ (connected with इन ?),
Ved. powerful, violent; an overbearing fellow; (Sāy.)
an instigator; [cf. इरस्य &c.]

ईरिन् ईरिन्, ई, m., N. of a man; (इणस्), m.
pl. the descendants of this man.

इरिमेद इरिमेद, अस्, m., N. of a plant, =
अरि-मेद.

इरिम्बिठि इरिम्बिठि, इस्, m., N. of a man of
the family of Kāṇva, author of several hymns of the
Ṛg-veda.

इरिविल्ला इरिविल्ला or इरिवेल्लिका, f. pimples
or pustules on the head.

ईरित, अस्, आ, अम्, sent, despatched; said, uttered.
—ईरिताकूत (˚त-आक्˚), अम्, n. declared purpose or
intention.
